description: Remove one block from a page's draft by its instance id. Looks in the content blocks first, then the layout blocks; every other block stays as it was. The published page keeps the block until publish_page. Fails with "Block not found on page" when no block has that id, so a repeat call errors rather than removing anything else. To change a block instead, use update_block_content or patch_block_content. Returns { pageId, blockId }.

blockId.description: Block instance id (UUID) to remove, from the blocks or layoutBlocks of get_page

name: remove_block_from_page
title: Remove block from page
